test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and courses of action carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement is true, decide which of the given courses of action logically follows for pursuing.

**Statement:**

The traffic congestion in the city has significantly increased during peak hours.

Courses of Action:

I. Improve public transportation infrastructure and services to provide viable alternatives to private vehicles.

II. Impose hefty fines on individual drivers during peak hours.

options.text: Both Course of Action I and Course of Action II follow
Neither Course of Action I nor Course of Action II follows
Only Course of Action I follows
Only Course of Action II follows

solution:
The given statement highlights the problem of heavy traffic during the peak hours. Improving public transportation infrastructure and services is a good solution to attract people to use public transport instead of private vehicles. This ultimately will reduce the traffic. Hence, action I can be pursued.

Impose hefty fines on individual drivers during peak hours cannot be an option as they are not doing anything illegal. They have the right to use their car at any time. Hence, action II cannot be pursued.

Hence, the correct answer is** "****Only Course of Action I follows"**.
